GOAL (user-authorized increment, current-round user requirements take priority): a MINIMAL, FAST-TO-WORK **MOCK** SSE endpoint for skin-report narration text, for client integration testing. Explicit non-goals: no real algorithm, no RAG, no AI calls, no secrets/config reads, no medical advice, no complex report generation, no broad testing, no Last-Event-ID/resume/replay/persistence/cancel API, no deployment. This endpoint is not designed in any backend/doc design document — it follows the gimbal-ai precedent (user-authorized increment, catalog-only, NOT added to backend/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml).

USER SPEC the commit must satisfy:
1. GET /api/v1/skin-assessment-tasks/{taskId}/report-narration-stream, Accept: text/event-stream.
2. Reuse existing gimbal Bearer/device-token auth + current-task isolation; GIMBAL principals only; taskId must be the gimbal's current task; reuse AssessmentReadService/SkinReportService authorization (no second rule set); stream only when existing task state allows reading this report; pre-stream errors via existing JSON error envelope system (this repo's problem+json equivalent = ErrorEnvelope/GlobalExceptionHandler).
3. Fixed mock region JSON (F/L/R/C × O/P/D scores+labels) embedded verbatim; region score = arithmetic mean of O/P/D rounded HALF_UP → F61 L39 R67 C45.
4. Concatenated narration text must be EXACTLY: 本次完成额头、左脸、右脸和下巴四个区域的皮肤检测。额头61分，左脸39分，右脸67分，下巴45分。
5. SSE events start/text_delta/done/error; every data JSON has requestId/taskId/reportId/seq; text_delta adds delta; seq strictly increasing; done/error mutually exclusive; ≥2 text_delta each flushed (proves streaming); connection close ends send.
6. Existing JSON report endpoints unchanged; data/generator clearly labeled MOCK; OpenAPI/contract synced per repo convention (catalog-only chosen); must NOT touch backend/doc/site, backend/doc/web, logs/, other packages.
7. Lean verification only: one focused IT (route + event order + delta concatenation == exact text) reusing existing auth-test patterns + at most one key rejection scenario; full suite NOT run by design.

FILES (under backend/web-java/src): main/java/cn/yuanxin/mvp/web/assessments/narration/{MockReportNarrationGenerator,ReportNarrationStreamController,ReportNarrationStreamErrorAdvice}.java; main/java/cn/yuanxin/mvp/web/docs/catalog/ReportNarrationStreamDocs.java; test/java/cn/yuanxin/mvp/web/assessments/ReportNarrationStreamIT.java.

IMPLEMENTATION DECISIONS to scrutinize:
(a) Pre-stream checks on request thread, in order: principalType!=GIMBAL → 403 CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED; generator ObjectProvider empty (production fail-closed: generator is @Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)) → 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; AssessmentReadService.getTask(taskId,principal) (internally: not-visible→404 RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE, pointer mismatch→409 TASK_REPLACED); view.reportId()==null (status!=report_ready) → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE. Then ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM).cacheControl(noStore()).body(StreamingResponseBody) with writeEvent framing ("event: X\ndata: <json>\n\n" + flush per event), seq 1..4 (start=1, deltas=2,3, done=4), requestId=principal.requestId() captured in closure.
(b) DEVIATION — added scoped ReportNarrationStreamErrorAdvice (@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes=ReportNarrationStreamController.class), @Order(HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE), handles ApiException only): root cause = with produces=text/event-stream and client Accept: text/event-stream, GlobalExceptionHandler's ResponseEntity<Map> has no preset Content-Type → Spring content negotiation cannot match JSON → HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException → pre-stream 403/404/409/503 would degenerate to 500. The advice emits the identical ErrorEnvelope (via EnvelopeSupport+ErrorEnvelope, same code/message/retryable/details/headers) with Content-Type: application/json preset. Fixer empirically confirmed removing `produces` does not fix it. Scope limited to the new controller; no existing class touched.
(c) Client disconnect (IOException on write/flush) → silent stop, no terminal event. Unexpected RuntimeException mid-stream → best-effort exactly one `error` terminal {requestId,taskId,reportId,seq,code:INTERNAL_ERROR,message:报告播报生成失败} (fixed safe fields, no exception detail/stack).
(d) Docs: ReportNarrationStreamDocs catalog entry (mirrors GimbalAiDocs gating: @Conditional(NonProductionCondition)+@ConditionalOnProperty springdoc.api-docs.enabled), one Chinese tag, Chinese summary/description disclosing MOCK nature + event contract + limitations; errorCodes AUTH_REQUIRED/SESSION_INVALID/CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED/RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE/TASK_REPLACED/DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; SuccessDoc.binary("200",...,"text/event-stream").
(e) Test: ReportNarrationStreamIT (RANDOM_PORT, TestDatabase PG, @Primary always-valid PrincipalRevalidator, local minimal fixtures seeding gimbal+pointer+report_ready task; does NOT modify shared test support). Exactly 2 tests: happy-path streaming (order start→text_delta×2→done, seq 1..4, requestId==X-Request-Id header, delta1+delta2 byte-exact == required text, exactly one terminal, no error event) + single rejection (APP token → 403 JSON envelope CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED).

VERIFICATION EVIDENCE (orchestrator ran personally after implementation, at the committed tree state): `mvn -B -Dtest=ReportNarrationStreamIT test` → Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, rc=0, BUILD SUCCESS; `mvn -B -Dtest=ApiDocsCoverageIT test` → Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, rc=0, ApiDocsApplier log catalogs=7 covered=36/36 missing=0. Full suite intentionally NOT run per user instruction (no existing file touched; new files only).

KNOWN LIMITATIONS already accepted/disclosed (flag only if you consider one a true BLOCKER for this mock scope): no Last-Event-ID/resume/replay/persistence/cancel (per spec); non-ApiException MVC-layer errors under Accept: text/event-stream (e.g. malformed UUID path variable → MethodArgumentTypeMismatch) still degenerate to 500 via global handler; theoretical edge where a RuntimeException after partially-written `done` could emit `error` after a partial done frame (not a parseable terminal); region labels/scores are fixed mock data unrelated to real vendor O/P/D semantics.

DELIVER: a SHORT review — verdict PASS / PASS-with-notes / BLOCKED; if BLOCKED list each blocker with file:line and minimal fix; notes optional and bounded. Explicitly state the reviewedCommit SHA your verdict binds to, and whether the scope (new-files-only, no contract/doc-site/logs touch) is confirmed from the commit diff.
